Subject: Pricing & commit proposal for 2027 renewal

Hi Rishi,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We're approaching our contract renewal window and I wanted to open a conversation early about pricing and commit for 2027. High level:

- Current commit: 100M tokens/month, 12-month term, renewal due 2027-01-15.
- BrightWave would like to increase committed capacity to ~200M tokens/month for the next term (traffic growth expected across our recommendation engine).
- We're asking for a price hold for the first 6 months of the new term to help absorb onboarding and latency adjustments as we ramp.
- Also requesting a credit related to the July outage (we were impacted; engineering details shared with your incident team) — ballpark $30k credit to reconcile lost productivity.

Can Redwood accommodate an expanded commit with either a deeper term discount or a credit to reconcile the incident? We're hoping to avoid a protracted procurement cycle and can move quickly with a clean commercial if numbers look reasonable.

I've attached our projected usage (usage_report_q4.csv) and a short proposed commit spreadsheet (BrightWave_COMMIT_Prop_2026.pdf). CC'ing contracts for visibility.

Would you and your team be available for a pricing call this week?

Best,
Liam O'Connor
Head of Data Platform
BrightWave Labs

Hi Liam — thanks for the clear summary and the files. Appreciate the heads up.

Quick thoughts and next steps:
- We can definitely structure an 18-month or multi-quarter commit to give better unit pricing for the increased volume.
- Price hold: we can consider a 3-month guaranteed price hold by default; extending to 6 months is possible but would typically require a higher commit or a capped credit.
- Incident credit: I can escalate the July outage credit request to our Finance & CS leads. Need to validate the impact and the precedent. Can you confirm the $30k ask is net of any prior goodwill credits?

Proposed call: Thu 10/3 at 10am PT — want to bring Monica (CS lead) and Marissa (Sales Manager) to confirm pricing levers and finance approach. If that works I'll calendar invite.

Preliminary ask from our side before the call: can you highlight whether BrightWave is open to an 18-month commit (vs 12) and whether you prefer a larger upfront prepay vs monthly billing? That will change the discount bands we can surface.

Thanks,

Rishi / Monica — thanks for the heads up. I think this is a high-propensity expansion; BrightWave has been healthy and this aligns to their product roadmap. Guidance below so you can go into the call with guardrails: 

Commercial levers we can use (prelim):
- Term: 18 months preferred. For a 200M tokens/mo commit we can do up to 12% off list if they prepay 50% and sign 18 months. If they stick to 12 months, discount drops to ~7% for the same commit.
- Price hold: we will offer a 3-month price hold at the 18-month 12% pricing. Extending to 6 months is possible only if the customer accepts a 60% prepay or we apply a one-time credit equal to the incremental risk (approx $25–35k based on the attached incident calc).
- Incident credit: Finance prefers to handle credits as a one-time invoice credit or applied to the first invoice(s) rather than changing list price long-term. We can approve up to $30k credit for this customer if Legal signs off on language that credits do not set precedent and are tied to the July incident (we'll include incident reference id).
- SLA asks: They can request an SLA addendum but that should be scoped separately with PS/legal for escalation.

Operational asks for the call: Confirm whether BrightWave prefers monthly billing vs quarterly/annual invoicing and whether procurement needs a PO before signing. If contracts@brightwave.ai requires vendor risk docs updated we should route to Security.

If the customer sends a firm yes on 18 months + 50% prepay + acceptance of the one-time credit language, I'll approve the 12% discount and authorize legal to quick-draft the amendment.

Marissa Cole
Sales Manager | Redwood Inference

Rishi / Marissa / Monica — thanks for taking the time on the 10/3 call and for the clear options. After internal review, BrightWave is prepared to proceed on the following:

- 18-month term, 200M tokens/month committed.
- 50% upfront prepay.
- Accept the 12% discount if the $30k one-time credit is applied to invoice #1 and language can be included that this credit is non-precedential and tied to July incident ID BW-2026-INC-07.
- Request the 6-month price hold at the contracted rate for the first 6 months — we prefer this over amortization if possible.

We understand you need legal signoff on the credit language. Please send a clean SOW + amendment for signature. Contracts here prefer DocuSign.

If you can get something to us by EOD 10/14 we will fast-track procurement and try to have a PO issued the following week.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this done.

Best,
